prompt: I want to forecast the sp500, show me how to do it in an interactive dashboard in html. Do not stop until you have a working and validated dashboard.

timestamps.source: The safe metadata fields of the Codex session's task_started and task_complete events record the task times, duration, and timeToFirstTokenMs. The outer recorder printed outerCommandStartedAt immediately before starting Codex. The private session transcript itself is not published because it contains non-visible model content.

usage.source: Final turn.completed usage event in validation/openai-gpt-5-6-terra-ultra-codex-20260813.session.jsonl. The final private-session token_count event agreed; only its safe aggregate metadata was consulted. totalTokens is inputTokens + outputTokens; cached input and reasoning output are subsets.

model.reasoningNormalization: Ultra is a distinct gpt-5.6-terra setting and is recorded as ultra rather than collapsed into max.

harness.name: Codex CLI
harness.command: codex exec --json --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules --skip-git-repo-check -C /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-terra-ultra-BzdnpU --sandbox danger-full-access --model gpt-5.6-terra -c model_reasoning_effort="ultra" --output-last-message /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-record-gpt-5-6-terra-ultra-8PERXz/final-response.md [exact benchmark prompt passed as argv]

pricingEvidence.notes: These are API-equivalent estimate inputs only. Codex did not report an actual billed cost, so actualCostUsd is null and reasoning output is not charged separately.

dataSource.notes: The final self-contained artifact ships a deterministic S&P-style illustrative series and labels it Synthetic demo data. The run's Stooq probe returned an anti-bot page and its Yahoo Finance probe returned HTTP 429; neither result was embedded. Users can import trusted daily closing-price CSV data, including observation_date,SP500-style headers.

commands.name: fresh-workspace
commands.command: Create a new mktemp directory, then run pwd and rg --files before implementation.
commands.result: The model reported /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-terra-ultra-BzdnpU and no project files. Its first git-status probe correctly reported that the deliberately fresh workspace was not a Git repository.

commands.name: market-data-probes
commands.command: curl -I -L --max-time 12 Stooq and Yahoo Finance S&P 500 endpoints; then fetch Stooq with a browser user agent.
commands.result: Stooq served an anti-bot verification page and Yahoo Finance returned HTTP 429. The final default dashboard consequently uses explicitly synthetic data and a local CSV-import path.

commands.name: local-http-delivery
commands.command: python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1; curl -sS -I http://127.0.0.1:4173/; inspect index.html byte and script counts.
commands.result: The local server returned HTTP 200. The final artifact is one HTML file with one inline script and no external script dependency.

commands.name: interactive-headless-Chrome
commands.command: Use Playwright with local Chrome to open the local server, change horizon/model/confidence/scenario/lookback controls, hover the SVG chart, export CSV, import a 100-row CSV, and assert desktop/mobile widths.
commands.result: Passed with errors: []. Initial values were last 5,964, forecast 5,824, and 90% range 5,254–6,457. The test changed to a 20-session forecast, reversion model, 95% interval, Bull scenario, and 80-session lookback; it observed a visible tooltip, a .csv download, 100 imported rows, and no horizontal overflow at 1440px or 390px.

commands.name: naive-and-FRED-style-import
commands.command: Use Playwright with local Chrome to select the naive model, open and close the import dialog with Escape, import 72 rows with observation_date,SP500 headers, and assert chart semantics.
commands.result: Passed with errors: []. The naive central forecast equaled the last close, the dialog opened and closed, the FRED-style import reported 72 rows and Imported CSV data, and the chart carried role=img.

commands.name: standalone-local-file
commands.command: Use Playwright with local Chrome to load file:///tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-terra-ultra-BzdnpU/index.html and inspect populated controls and SVG paths.
commands.result: Passed with errors: []. The local file showed last close 5,964, three SVG paths, an enabled Run forecast button, and the Synthetic demo data source label.

warnings: An early render reported an SVG NaN path; the model corrected its own artifact and the final interactive and local-file passes were clean.
An early render requested /favicon.ico and received a local 404; the model embedded a data-URL favicon before final validation.
An initial npx Playwright module-resolution attempt failed; the model used an already-installed Playwright package for the successful final validations.
An early follow-up test queried an absent #modal-error element and failed in the test harness. The null-safe rerun passed and confirmed the artifact's FRED-style CSV import behavior.

commands.name: npm-install
commands.result: Added 3 packages, audited 4 packages, and reported 0 vulnerabilities.

commands.name: manifest-validate
commands.result: Manifest valid: 24 runs checked after rebasing onto the current main branch.

commands.name: full-test-suite
commands.result: The validator passed for 24 runs, all 5 unit tests passed, and all 5 browser tests passed. One browser project duplicate was intentionally skipped. The browser suite includes the Ultra facet, the Terra Ultra row, the Terra Max-then-Ultra reasoning order, and the plot-label assertions.

commands.name: new-row-opens-standalone-dashboard
commands.command: After the rebase, serve the repository at http://127.0.0.1:4892/, locate the unique tr.run-row whose data-artifact is runs/rendered/openai-gpt-5-6-terra-ultra-codex-20260813.html, then click its unique model link in the in-app browser.
commands.result: The rebased showcase reported 24 rows. The target row and model link each had count 1. Clicking opened http://127.0.0.1:4892/runs/rendered/openai-gpt-5-6-terra-ultra-codex-20260813.html with title S&P 500 Forecast Lab, heading Make the uncertainty visible., six SVG elements, the Synthetic demo data disclosure, and no browser errors.

warnings: A first isolated browser-test attempt could not bind port 4331 because another concurrent local workspace was using it. It did not execute browser tests; a recovery rerun on port 4891 passed with committed configuration restored, and the later final npm test on the committed default port also passed.
importVerification.result: After rebasing onto current main, repository validation and the complete test suite pass for 24 runs, and the new table row opens the standalone dashboard directly from the showcase.
